name: redwood-light
title: Redwood light
description: A redwood forest in early morning: giant trunks fading into blue-green haze, golden light shafts slanting onto a fern floor, and slow motes drifting in the light.

name: balloon-valley
title: Balloon valley
description: Early morning over a river valley in halftone dots on cream: cool blue hills fading into haze, pale gold mist, a river catching the low sun and hot-air balloons at different depths.

name: canyon-river
title: Canyon river
description: A desert canyon in late golden hour from a high rim: sunlit terracotta walls with blue shadows step back to glowing buttes while a river winds below, mirroring the blue sky.

name: lighthouse
title: Lighthouse
description: A lighthouse on a rocky headland at blue hour, its lamp glowing amber over a calm sea, painted in halftone dots.

name: glacier-lagoon
title: Glacier lagoon
description: Icebergs glowing blue-white on a glassy lagoon below a glacier and dark peaks, under a midnight sun sitting gold and rose on the horizon.

name: rice-terraces
title: Rice terraces
description: Flooded rice terraces at a fresh dawn: silver-blue fields between dark earthen banks with lit grassy tops, mist in the valley and far ridges fading into haze.
